main.description: Compose an app.bsky.feed.post of an aggregate ad-tech-transparency finding. OUTWARD-GATED (sukashi G11): live atproto posting requires SUKASHI_LIVE_POST + operator auth, and every post body passes a Charter Rider §2(a)-(h) scan before it can be emitted. AGGREGATE-FIRST only (G3); the post NEVER names a real firm as fraudulent — sukashi does not adjudicate (G4).

text.description: the post body — aggregate finding only; never names a real firm as fraudulent (G4); passes Charter Rider §2(a)-(h) scan (G11)

reportCid.description: optional KotobaCid of the backing intel report (publishIntelReport)

langs.description: optional BCP-47 language tags for the post (app.bsky.feed.post langs)

sourcing.description: sukashi G5; an aggregate-finding post is typically :synthesized
